name: Harukanaru Koushinkyoku de
source:
"Believing that someday it might reach them, I keep the transmission going today, too."

You picked up a stuffed toy.
It had been abandoned, all alone, beneath a streetlight on a road at night.

It wasn't long after that—
that you heard a "voice" coming from the stuffed toy.

A visual novel in which you talk with a girl(?) from a distant planet.
Please don't forget that every choice is a choice made by "you."

For "you," the girl on the other side of the screen is truly living in her own world [planet].
I pray that your choices come from the heart.

Ending: One. However, every ending should be different for you.
Estimated play time: Around 2–3 hours.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10971]Novel Game Collection[/url]]
